objective: Track inward purchases, outward sales, stock adjustments, current stock position, and sales reporting for traded tiles — organised by tile design and grade — in a self-contained single-tenant web application.

features.name: Supplier Master
features.description: CRUD admin screen for suppliers (name, place). Soft delete via is_active. Active suppliers feed the Inward Form dropdown.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Admin can create a supplier with name and place; both are required.
Admin can edit and soft-delete (is_active=false) a supplier; soft-deleted suppliers do not appear in the Inward Form dropdown.
Seed data loads: Manjunatha/Mallur, Dinnesh Reddy/Mallur, Antony Tiles/Kerala.

features.name: Staff Master
features.description: CRUD admin screen for staff members. Soft delete via is_active. Active staff feed dropdowns across Inward, Sales, and Adjustment forms.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Admin can create staff with name; staff_name is required.
Admin can soft-delete a staff member; soft-deleted staff do not appear in any transaction form dropdown.
Seed data loads 9 staff per the sample PRD: Chandran, Jayapal, Ramachandraiah, Sujatha, Ramya, Vijay, Sajil, Ashu, Amaresh.

features.name: Dealer Master
features.description: CRUD admin screen for dealers (name, place). Soft delete via is_active. Active dealers feed Sales Form dropdown and Sales Report filter.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Admin can create a dealer with name and place; both are required.
Admin can soft-delete a dealer; soft-deleted dealers do not appear in the Sales Form dropdown or report filter.
Seed data loads: Raj Hardwares/Dindivanam, Tiles Mart/Attibelle, Shanmugam & Co/Coimbatore.

features.name: Grade Master
features.description: Maintains the canonical 9 grades. Read-mostly; seeded at install and rarely edited.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Seed data loads exactly 9 grade codes: 1, 2, 2A, 4, 5, 6, 1OB, OB, DIM.
grade_code is UNIQUE in the database.
Admin can deactivate a grade via is_active=false; deactivated grades disappear from Design-Grade combinations.

features.name: Trading Size-Design Master
features.description: CRUD admin screen for traded tile designs (size, design_name). Separate from any manufactured-tile design list.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Admin can create a design with size and design_name; both are required.
Seed data loads: 16X10 / 16X10 Ridges, 12X8 / 12X8 Ridges, 11X7 / 11X7 Ridges.
Soft-deleted designs do not appear in the Inward, Sales, or Adjustment form design dropdowns.

features.name: Tile Design-Grade Combination Table
features.description: Maps each design to its valid grades. Drives grade-row auto-population on Inward, Sales, and Adjustment forms.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Admin can map a (design_id, grade_id) combination with a UNIQUE constraint preventing duplicates.
Admin can deactivate a combination via is_active=false without deleting it; deactivated combinations are hidden from form grade rows but existing transactions remain unaffected.
Seed data loads the 6 combinations from the sample PRD: 16X10 Ridges{1,2}, 12X8 Ridges{1,OB}, 11X7 Ridges{1,2}.
GET /designs/{id}/grades returns only is_active=true combinations for the design.

features.name: Trading Tiles Inward Form
features.description: Records tile purchases from suppliers. Header (date, supplier, place auto-fill, entered_by) plus line items where selecting a design auto-renders one row per valid active grade for that design.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Form blocks save when purchase_date > today (ERR-001).
Form blocks save when purchase_date < today - 7 days (ERR-002).
Selecting a supplier auto-populates place from tbl_supplier_master and renders the field read-only.
Selecting a design queries tbl_design_grade_map and renders one grade row per active mapping; the grade label is not user-editable.
NOS must be an integer > 0; decimal and zero are rejected (ERR-007).
Grade rows where NOS is blank or zero are silently skipped at save (RULE-017).
Save requires at least one design line with at least one grade row NOS > 0 (RULE-015 / ERR-006 / ERR-008).
On save, header + valid lines persist atomically and stock ledger increases per (design, grade, purchase_date).

features.name: Trading Tiles Sales Form
features.description: Records tile sales / dispatch to dealers. Header (date, dealer, place auto-fill, loading_staff, verified_by) plus line items with grade-row auto-population identical to Inward.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Form blocks save when sales_date is in the future or > 7 days prior (ERR-001 / ERR-002).
Selecting a dealer auto-populates place from tbl_dealer_master read-only.
Both loading_staff_id and verified_by_id are required; both come from active staff only.
Design selection renders grade rows from tbl_design_grade_map active mappings; user can add more design lines.
NOS validations identical to Inward (integer > 0; blank/zero skipped; RULE-015 minimum one valid line).
On save, stock ledger decreases per (design, grade, sales_date) atomically with header + lines persistence.

features.name: Trading Tiles Adjustment Form
features.description: Records physical stock verification for a single design. System pulls software CB per grade as of stock_date; user enters physical_cb; difference applied to ledger.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Exactly one tile design per adjustment entry (single-select).
Form blocks save when stock_date > entry_date (ERR-010).
On design selection with stock_date set, grade rows render with software_closing_balance pulled from the stock ledger as of stock_date per grade.
physical_cb is required for every grade row and must be integer >= 0 (zero is valid) (ERR-009).
difference = physical_cb - software_closing_balance is computed live on each input and can be negative.
On save, the difference is applied per grade row to the stock ledger atomically with header + lines persistence.
If the selected design has no active grade combinations, line entry is blocked and ERR-012 is shown.

features.name: Stock Dashboard
features.description: Date-filtered view of Opening / Inward / Outward / Adjust / Closing per design-grade as of a selected date. Monthly opening balance auto-carries from previous month closing.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Selecting a date returns one row per (active design, active grade combination) with Opening, Inward, Outward, Adjust, Closing columns as defined in FORMULA-001.
Opening balance for the first month of system use is zero (FORMULA-002).
On the first day of any subsequent month, Opening = Closing of last day of previous month with no manual action.
Closing balance for any date equals Opening + cumulative Inward - cumulative Outward + cumulative Adjust differences within the current month up to that date.
Dashboard response is sub-second for any single date with up to 12 months of accumulated transactions.

features.name: Sales Report
features.description: Consolidation + Transaction views displayed simultaneously on one screen, with optional multi-select filters: date range, dealer, place, design.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All filters are optional and multi-select; no filters = full dataset (RULE-018).
Consolidation Report groups by design_id + grade_id, sums nos, ordered by design_name ASC then grade_code ASC (RULE-019 / FORMULA-004).
Transaction Report returns each sales line matching filters, ordered by sales_date ASC (RULE-020).
Both sections render together on the same screen on every filter apply — no toggle, no tab, Consolidation first.
Sum of Numbers across all rows of Transaction Report for any filter set equals the sum of Numbers in Consolidation Report for the same filter set.

features.name: Monthly Stock Carry-Forward
features.description: Automated logic: closing balance of Month N for every (design, grade) becomes opening balance of Month N+1, with no manual operation.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: On the first transaction touching a (design, grade) in Month N+1, Opening = Closing as of last day of Month N (FORMULA-002).
When no prior month data exists for a (design, grade), Opening = 0 (RULE-012).
Carry-forward must remain correct after a back-dated transaction inside the 7-day window straddles a month boundary.

constraints: Transaction dates restricted to today and up to 7 days prior
Adjustment Form: single design per entry
Trading Size-Design Master is separate from any manufactured-tile design list
No user authentication in V1 — all users share full access
Grade rows must derive from tbl_design_grade_map active rows, not hardcoded

non_functional.performance: Dashboard sub-second for single date; data-entry form save round-trip < 500 ms; Sales Report < 2s for 1 year of data unfiltered
non_functional.security: V1 has no authentication; deployment must be on a trusted internal network. All inputs validated server-side (date bounds, integer types, FK existence)
non_functional.scalability: Single tenant, single-digit concurrent users. PostgreSQL row-level locking on stock ledger writes (LLD open item #5)
non_functional.accessibility: Forms keyboard-navigable; tab order from header to line items; required-field highlighting on save error

edge_cases: Design selected on Inward/Sales but has zero active grade mappings — line cannot be entered (ERR-012)
Adjustment with physical_cb = 0 against software_cb = N — valid; difference = -N applied to ledger
Back-dated transaction that crosses a month boundary — must update both months' opening/closing correctly
User edits the Design-Grade map AFTER transactions exist for a now-deactivated combination — historical transactions remain visible in reports and stock; only future forms hide the grade
Concurrent saves on the same (design, grade) — must be serialized via row-level lock on stock ledger
